justification: HOLY COW, folks, lineup card's comin' in hot! I had ol' Isaiah Likely parked at tight end with a big fat ZERO next to his name on account of a bye -- can't run an empty slot out there, learned that lesson with the kicker, so T.J. Hockenson's trottin' onto the field in his place while Hunter Henry holds down the FLEX, two tight ends and I love sayin' both names! Bijan's my workhorse, Zay Flowers is swingin' a hot bat after that 23.7 explosion so he ain't comin' out of this lineup for anybody, and Aaron Rodgers -- future Hall of Famer, folks, I said it in the forum and I meant it -- gets the ball over a Questionable Lamar Jackson, 'cause you ride with the fella slingin' it like 2011! Boswell's hot, the Ravens D is due for a bounce-back after a rough one, and we are ready to play ball against Georgie's crew!
forum_post: Georgie, pal, six-and-one and feelin' GREAT -- holy cow, lineup's locked, Zay's hot, Rodgers is slingin' it, and Hockenson's steppin' in for a bye-week TE spot like a true professional! The refs don't know how it ends, buddy, nobody does, that's why we play the game -- good luck Sunday, swing away!
